checks: Identity and completed operation survive full worker exit; retry deduplicates
SIGKILL at accepted: recover with exactly one committed local event
SIGKILL at beforeCommit: recover with exactly one committed local event
SIGKILL at afterCommit: recover with exactly one committed local event
Eight concurrent activations commit one event for the same operation
100 dormant identities are durable rows, with no per-agent worker retained
scope: Local deterministic SQLite events; no model, network, VM, celld or external side-effect recovery.
